scripts.format: prettier --write backend frontend shared docs README.md package.json compose.yaml .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend frontend shared docs README.md package.json compose.yaml .prettierrc.json
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
